access_links.label: Zenodo landing page and file inventory

description: Renewable Energy Systems releases six months of operating data from the Altahullion wind farm in Northern Ireland on behalf of its owner, TRIG. The deposit includes turbine locations, rated power, rotor diameters and hub heights for both farm phases. Separate archives hold one-minute and ten-minute turbine statistics and measurements from a ZX300 lidar near turbine T11; a deployment report is also listed. Zenodo provides the May 2026 release free under CC BY 4.0. The exact six-month observation dates and internal archive formats remain unknown from the landing-page description. The operational measurements can calibrate wind-farm and wake simulations, but availability of six months does not establish a full annual operating range. The data are supplied as-is and were not downloaded. The authors name the related catalogued Kelmarsh dataset as an inspiration, not as an input or technical dependency.
